title: Digital Asset, which builds Canton Network, a public blockchain with privacy features, raised $355M, including $100M from a16z crypto (Bloomberg Law)
summary: Bloomberg Law: Digital Asset, which builds Canton Network, a public blockchain with privacy features, raised $355M, including $100M from a16z crypto — Blockchain builder Digital Asset Holdings LLC raised $355 million in a new funding round led by Andreessen Horowitz's main crypto fund …
